hints.removeWrongMsg: This cat looks happy now, but it blocks a valid solution later. Try removing it!
hints.nudgeRegion: Take a closer look at the {{region}} region. It has fewer valid positions than the others.
hints.nudgeRow: Inspect row {{row}} closely — most of its tiles are already ruled out!
hints.nudgeCol: Inspect column {{col}} closely — only a narrow set of spots can hold a cat.
hints.explainRegion: Look at the open tiles of the {{region}} region: cats already placed block all of them but one.
hints.explainRow: In row {{row}}, cats already placed block every tile but one. Find the last open tile!
hints.explainCol: In column {{col}}, cats already placed block every tile but one. Find the last open tile!
hints.explainIntersection: Every open tile of the {{helperRegion}} region sits in a single row or column, so that line belongs to it. Rule out the other tiles of that line, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainAdjacency: A cat on certain tiles would block every remaining spot of the {{helperRegion}} region, so those tiles are impossible. Rule them out, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainLineRegion: Every open tile of {{line}} lies inside the {{helperRegion}} region, so that region's cat must be on it. Rule out the region's other tiles, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainLineAdjacency: A cat on certain tiles would block every remaining spot of {{line}}, so those tiles are impossible. Rule them out, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainGroup: Some regions are squeezed into the same few rows or columns, so those lines are reserved for them. Rule out the other tiles there, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainContradiction: Try a “what if”: a cat on certain tiles would leave a region, row or column with no open tile at all. Rule those tiles out, then look at the {{region}} region.
hints.explainFallback: This step needs a long chain of reasoning. Focus on the {{region}} region — the next hint stage shows the exact tile.
hints.stage4ConfirmMsg: Confirm to place a guaranteed cat in the {{region}} region (row {{row}}, col {{col}}).
hints.regionDeductionMsg: Only one safe spot remains in the {{region}} region — a cat must hide here!
hints.rowDeductionMsg: Row {{row}} has only one valid cell left. Place a cat here!
hints.colDeductionMsg: Column {{col}} has only one valid cell left. Place a cat here!
hints.spotNearbyMsg: Try the {{region}} tile at row {{row}}, col {{col}} — it keeps every row, column, and neighbor clear!
hints.spotBasicMsg: A cat belongs in the {{region}} region at row {{row}}, col {{col}}.

tutorial.controlsTip: Tap to select, tap again to place a cat. Drag across tiles in <bold>Mark ×</bold> mode!

1.title: One Cat per Color
1.subtitle: Each colored area hides exactly one cat. Mark the rest with ×!
1.voice: Rule one: One cat per color. Every colored region hides exactly one cat. Mark the empty tiles with an X to narrow it down!

2.title: One per Row & Column
2.subtitle: No two cats can share the same horizontal row or vertical column.
2.voice: Rule two: One cat per row and column. No two cats can share the same horizontal row or vertical column.

3.title: Cats Never Touch
3.subtitle: Cats love space! Keep all 8 surrounding tiles clear — even diagonally.
3.voice: Rule three: Cats never touch. Keep all eight surrounding tiles clear around every cat, including diagonals!
